Bollynights Newcastle – Diwali Special 🪔 | Kala Chashma 🕶️ | Wednesday 11th November | Digital

Newcastle, get your Kala Chashma ready! 🕶️🔥

Celebrate Diwali with BollyNights at Digital for a night of Bollywood favourites, Punjabi bangers and Desi dancefloor anthems! Gather your friends, bring the festive energy and get ready to light up the dancefloor. ✨

🎁 FREE Kala Chashma sunglasses for the first 50 customers through the door! Arrive early to claim yours.

 ▬▬▬ •★• INFO •★• ▬▬

📅 Wednesday 11th November 🕚 Start Time: 11pm🕒 End Time: 3am📍 Venue: Digital Newcastle 🎟️ Online Advanced Tickets starting from £5🚨 PLEASE NOTE: OVER 18s ONLY 🚨⏰ Last Entry: 12.30am👫 Mixed Groups Advised📸 Bring Valid Physical ID: Passport, BRP, or British Driving License & Student ID will also be required 

▬▬▬ •★• MUSIC •★• ▬▬▬

Bollywood | Desi | South Indian 

For more info message us directly on instagram - https://www.instagram.com/boll...

Join our What's App group for Newcastle -  https://chat.whatsapp.com/Gkf1...
